name: SND@LHC detector
notes: Status shutdown: the detector has a sourced 'active' interval from 2022 (the collaboration's 2023 PRL, arXiv:2305.09383, states data were collected 'in 2022'), capped at the LHC-wide start of Long Shutdown 3 as in experiment:snd-lhc.

Technology and the TI18/480 m placement are corroborated by the SND@LHC detector-description paper (arXiv:2210.02784), which states the detector sits '480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point, in the TI18 tunnel'; the notes of site:cern-ti18-snd-lhc still flag the site's lat/lon as unverified.

placements.quote: The experiment is located 480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point, in the TI18 tunnel.

total_mass.note: This is the tungsten target mass only, not a total detector mass (no overall detector mass figure was found in a citable sentence).
total_mass.quote: The detector is composed of a hybrid system based on an 830 kg target made of tungsten plates, interleaved with emulsion and electronic trackers.

summary.plain: The SND@LHC detector sits in a disused CERN tunnel opposite FASER, built to catch neutrinos and rare particles from LHC collisions. It operated from 2022 until the LHC's current maintenance shutdown began in 2026.
summary.technical: Compact stand-alone detector in the TI18 tunnel, 480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point: an 830 kg tungsten target interleaved with emulsion and electronic trackers (also acting as an electromagnetic calorimeter), followed by a hadronic calorimeter and a muon identification system. Operated 2022 - June 2026; off since CERN's Long Shutdown 3 began.

technology.quote: The detector is composed of a hybrid system based on an 830 kg target made of tungsten plates, interleaved with emulsion and electronic trackers, also acting as an electromagnetic calorimeter, and followed by a hadronic calorimeter and a muon identification system.
technology.value: Hybrid emulsion/electronic-tracker target (tungsten plates) acting as an electromagnetic calorimeter, followed by a hadronic calorimeter and a muon identification system
